Name: Bestial Roar
Description: You release a loud, monstrous roar mimicking those of ravenous beasts, causing shockwaves around you. Each creature within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and knocked prone.
At Higher Levels: This spell's radius increases by 5 feet when you reach 5th level (15 feet), 11th level (20 feet), and 17th level (25 feet).
Sourcebook: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt
